items.definition:
opposite; back side
He put the car in reverse.

immoral act
He confessed his sins.

the state of continuing to live or exist
Survival in the wilderness is difficult.

a room in a hospital; a district
She was moved to the children's ward.

permission for something to happen or agreement to do something
You need parental consent to participate.

the action or process of causing so much damage to something that it no longer exists or cannot be repaired
The earthquake caused widespread destruction.

the development of events outside a person's control, regarded as predetermined
It was fate that brought them together.

the rate at which something occurs or is repeated
The frequency of his visits increased.

a unit of heredity
Genes determine many of our characteristics.

high renown or honor won by notable achievements
He fought for the glory of his country.

the main office or center of an organization
The company's headquarters are in London.

property that is or may be inherited; valued things passed down from previous generations
The building is part of our national heritage.

the ability to assess and initiate things independently; an act or strategy intended to resolve a difficulty or improve a situation
She showed great initiative in her new role.

reasoning conducted or assessed according to strict principles of validity
There's no logic in his argument.

a goal or aim
Our main objective is to finish the project on time.

the state or condition of being free from being observed or disturbed by other people
Everyone deserves a certain level of privacy.

a person's home; the place where someone lives
The official residence of the President is the White House.

an official representative of a country
The ambassador delivered a speech.

the act of consuming
Energy consumption has increased.

dishonest or fraudulent conduct by those in power
The government is fighting corruption.

an idea, feeling, or opinion about something or someone
He made a good impression on me.

a person or company that makes goods for sale
The car manufacturer recalled several models.

act of taking away
The removal of the old tree improved the view.

order
The events happened in a strange sequence.

person who uses terror
The government is fighting against terrorist groups.

a person who has not had sexual intercourse
The story is about a young virgin.

an independent country or community
The Commonwealth consists of many nations.

person who puts money into something
The company is looking for new investors.

freedom
The statue symbolizes liberty and freedom.

the act of observing
The continuous monitoring of the patient's vital signs is crucial.

a mass meeting of people to show support or protest
Thousands attended the political rally.

the action of speaking or acting on behalf of someone
Every citizen deserves fair representation in government.

a person who has had long experience in a particular field
He is a veteran of the music industry.

a period of rapid economic growth
The city experienced a housing boom last year.

something, typically money, awarded to someone as recompense for loss, injury, or suffering
She received compensation for the damages.

the nature of something's ingredients or constituents
The composition of the soil affects plant growth.

the protection of animals, plants, and natural resources
Wildlife conservation is very important.

the degree of compactness of a substance
The density of water is higher than that of ice.

a group of vehicles or ships operating together
The company has a large fleet of delivery trucks.

exceptional intellectual or creative power
Albert Einstein was a scientific genius.

the process of infecting or the state of being infected
The doctor prescribed antibiotics for the infection.

the state of being pregnant
She announced her pregnancy last month.

an artificial body placed in orbit around the earth or another planet
The satellite transmits data back to Earth.

a statistic or piece of data
Can you give me the latest sales stats?

the action or process of transmitting something
The transmission of the disease was rapid.

a destructive wave of highly compressed air spreading outward from an explosion
The blast shattered the windows.

the state of being diverse; variety
The company values diversity in its workforce.

the teaching staff of a university or college, or an inherent mental or physical power
The university faculty met to discuss the new curriculum.

the human race; human beings collectively
We must protect the planet for the sake of humanity.

the action or process of innovating
The company is known for its constant innovation.

a list or an item in a list
The real estate agent showed us a new listing.

a collection of weapons or resources
The country built up its arsenal of modern weapons.

an organized collection of data
The company stores all customer information in a secure database.

unfair treatment of a person or group
There should be no discrimination based on race or gender.

a state of confusion; a medical condition
The room was in complete disorder after the party.

an area of knowledge or activity; a territory
Physics is outside my domain of expertise.

a formal agreement to get married; involvement; a battle
Their engagement was announced last week.

raw, unedited film or video material
The news channel showed exclusive footage of the event.

psychology
He is studying psychology at university.

restriction
There are new restrictions on travel.

ruin
The old castle is now a ruin.

slave
Historically, many people were forced to live as slaves.

stability
The country needs economic stability.

terminal
We arrived at Terminal 3 for our flight.
